content: {"witnessCode": "import { describe, it } from 'node:test'; import { strict as assert } from 'node:assert'; import normalizeUrl from '../index.js';\\n\\ndescribe('normalizeUrl leading slash preservation', () => {\\n  it('should keep leading slash when pathname contains no protocol pattern', () => {\\n    const input = 'http://example.com//foo//bar';\\n    const expected = 'http://example.com/foo/bar';\\n    const actual = normalizeUrl(input);\\n    assert.strictEqual(actual, expected);\\n  });\\n});"}
